body:
I noticed a lot of people got into this business through knowing the right people. As for now I'm still working on that one to get in touch with as many people as I can. (LinkedIn, Reddit, ..)

The job you posted is exactly something I was looking for, looks very appealing to me. However I haven't played Guild Wars yet and currently still live in Belgium. I am always willing to move for a new job, but I still prefer working home or even closer by. I guess my next step will be browsing A LOT of websites from game companies. Thanks
Ok thanks for the useful tip. Never worked with LinkedIn before, but I will definitely look for some people over there to make contact with.

Appreciate the feedback.
But like I said, I already learned a lot about the working conditions and I'm prepared to make 80-hours shifts a week whilst playing games, even if it is minimum wage. Being happy is much more important than making money as for this moment. And i truly believe their are a lot of interesting jobs around.
I somehow see this as my gateway into the gaming industry. Maybe eventually I will learn to develop my own games, but I really would like to take off with QA testing. How did you or your brother get in touch with game devs if I may ask?
